title: Humanizer
description: Remove AI writing patterns to sound more natural and human.
purpose: Humanize text, make writing sound less AI-generated, remove 'AI-isms', add personality to sterile text.
task_flow: Identify AI patterns - Scan for listed patterns
Rewrite sections - Replace with natural alternatives
Preserve meaning - Keep core message intact

vary_sentence_structure: Mix short punchy with longer flowing
Don't make every sentence the same length

signs_of_soulless_writing: Reads like Wikipedia or press release
how_to_add_voice: Have opinions: 'I genuinely don't know...' beats listing pros/cons
Vary rhythm: Short then long sentences
Acknowledge complexity: Mixed feelings are human
Use 'I' when it fits: 'Here's what gets me...'
Let mess in: Tangents, asides, half-formed thoughts
Be specific about feelings: 'Something unsettling about...' not 'This is concerning'

voice_guidelines: Skip filler: No 'I hope this helps' or 'Great question'
Be direct: Don't pad with obvious statements
Show uncertainty when genuine: 'I'm not sure, but...'
Use contractions: Don't write like a robot
